body:
A proposal that edits a task, feature or milestone now shows every field the agent sent (`solace_task.proposal_view`), so a one-line body fix shows the whole body again and the human can't see what moved.

**Server (`tasks.rs::proposal`):** when the proposal edits a record (`id` given), record the record's current value of each proposed field in the proposal as `before` (field → value), the same way the vision's `base` is kept. A field whose proposed value equals its current one is dropped from what is shown (keep it in `fields`, so Approve applies the same request). The question's `text` that the agent sees can stay as it is.

**Display (`solace_task.proposal_view`):**
- Edit: list only the changed fields. Short fields (title, feature, milestone, state, targetDate, dependsOn, rank) show `old → new`, records by title through `name`. The body shows as a diff: unchanged paragraphs collapsed, removed lines struck and added lines marked (a line diff is enough), with a toggle to see the new body rendered as Markdown.
- If nothing changes, say so ("No change").
- Create and vision proposals show as now; a vision proposal may use the same body diff against the current vision.
- A proposal saved before this (no `before`) shows as now.

**Tests:** a Rust test that an edit proposal carries `before`; Gleam tests that unchanged fields are hidden, that a short field shows old → new, and that the body diff marks added and removed lines.
title: plan: proposals show only what changes
